system.description: Ejecting an installed Charm with a loud, metallic click, a flash of light and a small blast of steam, this protocol allows the weaver to instantly replace one of his installed Charms with a Charm from his panoply (bypassing the need for downtime or visiting the vats) or to extend this benefit to another willing Alchemical. When the Alchemical sockets the new Charm into place, his body pulses with sequences of incandescent lights and hums softly as the Exalt's systems power back up.
